title: Maximize Warehouse Query Revenue in k Minutes
description_html:
You run a virtual warehouse with n types of queries. Query type i takes time[i] minutes to run and earns revenue[i]. You have a budget of k minutes and may run query types repeatedly (a type can be chosen any number of times). Choose queries to maximize total revenue within k minutes.

Output

The maximum achievable revenue, and the query type(s) selected to achieve it.

Example

time    = [2, 3, 4]     # minutes per query type
revenue = [3, 5, 6]     # earnings per query type
k = 6
----
max revenue = 10   (run query type 1 twice: 3+3 = 6 min, 5+5 = $10)

Better than 3×type0 (=$9) or type0+type2 (=$9).

Constraints

  • 1 ≤ n; 1 ≤ k. Times and revenues are positive.

This is an unbounded knapsack (max value within a budget, items reusable). See Notes for the DP, choice reconstruction, the trio, and references.
